target_customer: Clinical pathology and molecular labs, oncologists and biopharma that order cancer genomic testing
problem: Cancer genomic profiling is slow and expensive and often requires sending samples out. The company sells an assay (Duoseq) that profiles DNA and RNA from one sample in about two days and claims to cost about a tenth as much.
business_model: Diagnostic assay kits plus software and reporting sold to clinical labs

founders.name: Sandeep Dave
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page. The YC page gives no background, none found elsewhere in opened sources.

competitors.name: Foundation Medicine (FoundationOne CDx)
competitors.what: Comprehensive genomic profiling assay for solid tumors, 324 genes, DNA based
competitors.traction_then: First FDA approved comprehensive profiling assay for all solid tumors

competitors.name: Tempus (xO)
competitors.what: Matched tumor and normal DNA panel with whole transcriptome RNA sequencing

technical_complexity.rationale: Combined DNA and RNA library prep, sequencing workflow and clinical reporting software, plus clinical validation and regulatory support.

defensibility.rationale: Trademark on DUOSEQ and any clinical validations help, but larger firms had comparable assays.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large players launched DNA plus RNA panels in 2018 (Illumina TSO 500, Oncomine v3). Data Driven Bioscience remains a small company.

market_need_then: Labs wanted combined DNA and RNA tumor profiling and faster turnaround, and many vendors launched such assays in 2018. Cost and speed claims by this company were not independently verified.

branding.domain_note: datadrivenbioscience.com now redirects to duoseq.com, with the company shown as a ddb.bio service.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, short taglines such as Cancer Genomics Done Right

branding.brand_signature: DUOSEQ product brand and the one prep, one platform, one day line

brand_strength.rationale: Generic descriptive company name, little coverage, product brand Duoseq is the public face.

outcome_analysis: Data Driven Bioscience entered YC in summer 2018 with a promise of faster and cheaper cancer diagnosis and now markets the Duoseq DNA and RNA assay for clinical labs. No equity round beyond an unverified small seed was found, and one database reports NIH awards. The company is small and its status is partly unclear, with one directory marking it closed while its site is live.
notes: Aggregators list a 120K seed from Y Combinator and IT-Farm and NIH awards of about 1.3M for FY2025, all from single aggregator snippets, so unverified and not recorded as rounds. A MapQuest listing says Closed, conflicting with a live site. No outcome source found for shutdown or acquisition. Completeness pass: Recorded the CB Insights $120K seed (date not given; CB Insights mentions a Seed II in 2023-07 and 4 rounds) and the NIH awards totalling $1,323,523 for FY2025 per Healthcare Discovery; both single database. The recorded round rests on a single database or outlet and was not cross-checked by press.
